question: Benchmark datasets with specific crop-type labels (field or pixel level), already paired with multi-temporal Sentinel-2 data, under a licence that permits publishing results and sharing trained models.

requirements.text: Crop-type labels with specific crops (not cropland vs non-cropland)
Sentinel-2 time series already paired with labels (no own download/preprocessing)
Licence allows publishing results and sharing trained models

queries: agricultural parcels Sentinel-2 satellite image time series
land use land cover crop Sentinel-2 benchmark

record.title: PASTIS - Panoptic Segmentation of Satellite image TIme Series
record.description: Public dataset for Panoptic segmentation of agricultural parcels from satellite image time series. See companion github repository for more information.

notes: confirmed by the zenodo registry record zenodo:5012942
verification.found_title: PASTIS - Panoptic Segmentation of Satellite image TIme Series

datasets.why: Parcel-level semantic and panoptic crop labels with Sentinel-2 time series, ready as patches; the most used benchmark for crop segmentation. PASTIS-R adds Sentinel-1.

R1.evidence: Agricultural parcels with crop-type labels (from memory: 18 crop classes, France)

R3.evidence: Satellite image time series packaged with labels (record + companion GitHub)

access_steps: Download the archive(s) directly, no account needed (Zenodo access_right=open)
Optional: PASTIS-R (https://zenodo.org/records/5735646, 53.7 GB) for the S1+S2 version
caveats: Study area is four regions of France (from memory), so geographic generalisation is limited
Companion GitHub repo has loaders and baselines

record.title: EuroCropsML
record.description: EuroCropsML * is a ready-to-use ML dataset combining EuroCrops reference data with Sentinel-2 reflectance data from 2021. It contains data from Latvia, Portugal, and Estonia and is intended for benchmarking few-shot crop type classification. We used Eurostat's GISCO dataset to map the EuroCrops parcels to their NUTS1-3 region. The provided data comes in two stages: raw_data.zip (stage 1): One dataframe per country containing a annual time series of observations for each parcel, as well as separate files for the parcels' geometries and classes ( EC_hcat_c = 10-digit HCAT code indicating the hierarchy of the crop). preprocess.zip (stage 2): Read-to-use .npz -files. Each data point is saved in…

notes: confirmed by the zenodo registry record zenodo:15095445

datasets.why: Analysis-ready parcel-level Sentinel-2 time series with crop labels across 3 countries, designed for crop-type benchmarking.

R1.evidence: 176 crop classes, 706,683 labelled points (Sci. Data paper abstract)

R3.evidence: Sentinel-2 L1C reflectance time series from 2021, Latvia, Portugal, Estonia

R4.evidence: CC-BY-SA-4.0: publishing results is fine; share-alike applies to derived data/adaptations, and whether it reaches trained weights is legally unsettled

access_steps: Download the archive(s) directly, no account needed (Zenodo access_right=open)
caveats: Share-alike licence; check with your supervisor/institution before releasing models trained on it under a different licence
Per-parcel median values, not image patches, so no spatial context (suits time-series models, not segmentation)

record.title: TimeSen2Crop: a Million Labeled Samples Dataset of Sentinel 2 Image Time Series for Crop Type Classification
record.description: TimeSen2Crop is a pixel based dataset made up of more than 1 million samples of Sentinel 2 Time Series associated to 16 crop types, during an agronomic year ranging from September 2017 to August 2018. The dataset contains atmospherically corrected samples, as well as information related to snow, clouds and shadows. This benchmark dataset has been developed in the framework of the ExtremeEarth project, which received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement No 825258.

R3.evidence: Sentinel-2 time series Sept 2017 - Aug 2018 with cloud/snow info

record.title: Brazil-Crop dataset: a benchmark for agricultural remote sensing applications
record.description: Abstract Remote sensing facilitates the regular acquisition of agricultural information using non-invasive measurement techniques. Field data are essential for effective agricultural monitoring via remote sensing methods. Open and reliable field data are golden in the new Geospatial Artificial Intelligence (GeoAI) era. However, publicly available field data remain limited, particularly in tropical regions where agriculture exhibits considerable dynamism. This dataset seeks to address this gap by introducing a comprehensive crop type dataset that provides seasonal land use information across two distinct agricultural regions in Brazil. The dataset captures the temporal dynamics of Brazilian…

record.title: Dataset of Sentinel 2 Image Time Series for Multi-annual Crop Type Classification in Perú
record.description: This repository contains multi-annual crop classification data for the Chugay district, Peru. The main dataset, s2_cube.nc , contains processed Sentinel-2 imagery (August 2021–December 2024) used to generate crop classifications. The imagery was retrieved from Google Earth Engine collections: COPERNICUS/S2_SR , COPERNICUS/S2_CLOUD_PROBABILITY , and GOOGLE/CLOUD_SCORE_PLUS/V1/S2_HARMONIZED and processed using the Python function export_s2_images from the s2_gee_utils module in the Github repository https://github.com/kundun14/multi-annual-crop-classification-with-phenological-features . Additional datasets include: aoi.gpkg – Area of interest of the study region. fields.gpkg – Cropland bound…

not_recommended.name: EuroCrops
not_recommended.reason: Excellent parcel labels for 16 EU countries (CC-BY-SA-4.0) but no imagery; you would have to build the Sentinel-2 pipeline. EuroCropsML is the ready-made version.

not_recommended.name: IBM-NASA multi-temporal-crop-classification
not_recommended.reason: Open, CC-BY-4.0 and ready to use, but imagery is Harmonized Landsat-Sentinel (30 m) over the US with CDL-derived labels, not native Sentinel-2.

not_recommended.name: CROPSIGHT-US
not_recommended.reason: Ground-truth labels only (0.3 GB, US); not a packaged time-series benchmark.

gaps: Sen4AgriNet (https://github.com/Orion-AI-Lab/S4A) exists and is a Sentinel-2 multi-year, multi-country crop benchmark, but its GitHub page states no licence and downloads sit on Dropbox/Google Drive/HuggingFace; licence unconfirmed.
ZueriCrop (Switzerland, S2 time series, crop parcels) could not be located at an official data record; unconfirmed.
DENETHOR, TimeMatch, SICKLE and other datasets were not verified in this session.
